notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla implements the full questgiver dialog walk (CMSG_QUESTGIVER_STATUS_QUERY/HELLO/QUERY_QUEST/ACCEPT_QUEST/COMPLETE_QUEST/REQUEST_REWARD/CHOOSE_REWARD, CMSG_QUEST_QUERY) plus the two quest-log verbs (REMOVE, SWAP) and parses the SMSG_QUESTGIVER_* / SMSG_QUESTUPDATE_* / SMSG_QUEST_QUERY_RESPONSE / SMSG_QUESTLOG_FULL set. MSUI matches the whole set except the log-reorder verb.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The quest-share family (CMSG_QUEST_CONFIRM_ACCEPT / SMSG_QUEST_CONFIRM_ACCEPT / CMSG_PUSHQUESTTOPARTY / MSG_QUEST_PUSH_RESULT) is declared out of scope by Benilla itself (messages/quest/mod.rs: 'a separate solo slice'), so those pre-pass entries are not MSUI gaps against this reference.
